description: This file defines interfaces, classes, and data structures for managing F1AP protocol procedures in a 5G RAN, including UE context management, message handling, timers, and paging notifications.

classes.name: f1ap_rrc_message_transfer_procedure_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling RRC message transfer procedures, including transmitting RRC delivery reports.

classes.name: f1ap_ue_context_manager
classes.description: Interface for managing UE contexts, including creation, configuration, deletion, and release procedures.

classes.name: f1ap_ue_id_translator
classes.description: Interface for mapping between different UE identifiers used in the F1AP protocol.

classes.name: f1ap_ue_task_scheduler
classes.description: Interface for scheduling asynchronous tasks and timers for a specific UE.

classes.name: f1ap_task_scheduler
classes.description: Interface for scheduling asynchronous tasks at the DU level.

classes.name: f1ap_du_configurator
classes.description: Interface for DU configuration updates, including UE management and timers.

classes.name: f1ap_du_paging_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the DU of paging events.

classes.name: f1ap_du
classes.description: Main class combining all F1AP handling interfaces for the DU.

methods.name: handle_rrc_delivery_report
methods.description: Handles the transmission of RRC delivery reports.

methods.name: handle_ue_creation_request
methods.description: Processes requests to create new UE contexts.

methods.name: handle_ue_configuration_request
methods.description: Processes requests to update UE configurations.

methods.name: handle_ue_deletion_request
methods.description: Processes requests to delete UE contexts.

methods.name: handle_ue_context_release_request
methods.description: Handles UE context release procedures.

methods.name: handle_access_success
methods.description: Handles successful UE access notifications.

methods.name: handle_ue_context_modification_required
methods.description: Handles UE context modification procedures asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_ue_inactivity_notification
methods.description: Handles UE inactivity notifications.

methods.name: handle_notify
methods.description: Handles notify messages.

methods.name: has_gnb_cu_ue_f1ap_id
methods.description: Checks if a UE has a gNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID assigned.

methods.name: get_gnb_cu_ue_f1ap_id
methods.description: Retrieves gNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID from UE index or gNB-DU-UE-F1AP-ID.

methods.name: get_gnb_du_ue_f1ap_id
methods.description: Retrieves gNB-DU-UE-F1AP-ID from UE index or gNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID.

methods.name: get_ue_index
methods.description: Retrieves UE index from gNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID or gNB-DU-UE-F1AP-ID.

methods.name: create_timer
methods.description: Creates a timer for a UE.

methods.name: schedule_async_task
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous task for a UE or DU.

methods.name: get_timer_factory
methods.description: Retrieves the timer factory for DU-level timers.

methods.name: request_reset
methods.description: Requests reset of UE transaction info.

methods.name: find_free_ue_index
methods.description: Finds an unused UE index.

methods.name: request_ue_creation
methods.description: Requests creation of a new UE context.

methods.name: request_ue_context_update
methods.description: Requests update of an existing UE context.

methods.name: request_ue_removal
methods.description: Requests removal of a UE context.

methods.name: request_ue_drb_deactivation
methods.description: Requests deactivation of DRB activity for a UE.

methods.name: notify_reestablishment_of_old_ue
methods.description: Notifies DU of UE reestablishment.

methods.name: on_ue_config_applied
methods.description: Confirms UE configuration application.

methods.name: get_positioning_handler
methods.description: Retrieves positioning info handler.

methods.name: get_ue_handler
methods.description: Retrieves UE-specific task scheduler.

methods.name: on_paging_received
methods.description: Handles paging notifications.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Retrieves metrics collector.
